dataset_description: HEMOC is the largest freely available medical wiki of interventions, regimens, and general information relevant to hematology and oncology.
The Cancer Medications Enquiry Database (CanMED) is a two-part resource for cancer drug treatment studies. It uses National Drug Code (NDC) and Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS).
DrugBank identifiers, names and synonyms permit linkage into projects.
RxNorm provides normalized names for clinical drugs and links drug vocabularies.
The Enterprise Vocabulary Services provides NCI terminology content and tools.
SEER*RX supports coding oncology drug and regimen treatment categories in cancer registries.
